name: immich-machine-learning-openvino
description: Immich Machine Learning service with Intel OpenVINO GPU acceleration. Uses Intel iGPU (UHD/Iris Graphics) for ML inference. Works with Intel N100, N150, NUC, and other chips with integrated graphics. Handles face recognition, CLIP-based image search, and OCR using GPU-accelerated inference. Must be on the same Docker network as the Immich server.

paths.name: Path: USB Bus
paths.description: USB device bus. Required for Intel Neural Compute Stick or VPU devices. Can be removed if using only iGPU.

paths.name: Path: Model Cache
paths.description: ML model cache directory. Models are downloaded on first use (several GB).

variables.name: MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL_TTL
variables.description: Seconds of inactivity before unloading models from memory. Set to 0 to keep loaded permanently.

variables.name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKERS
variables.description: Number of ML worker processes. For multi-GPU setups, increase workers and set MACHINE_LEARNING_DEVICE_IDS (e.g. 0,1) to distribute workers across GPUs.

variables.name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKER_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds before a worker is considered unresponsive. GPU inference can be slow on first run.

variables.name: IMMICH_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: verbose, debug, log, warn, error

devices.name: Device: Intel iGPU
devices.description: Intel integrated GPU device. Required for OpenVINO acceleration.
